Package creatures

Class Creature

java.lang.Object
creatures.Creature
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionCapable
Direct Known Subclasses:
MagicCow, MagicDuck, MagicShark
public abstract class Creature extends Object implements ActionCapable
Creature is a base class that represents the generic magic creatures that stays in the magic farm.
